en: Vintage postcard with an Italian tricolour flag on the left and a red flag on the right, two oval portraits (a man in military uniform and a woman) above a central photograph of a medieval tower on a street. Floral decorations frame the images. Beneath the tower photograph is the caption "Trento - Torre Vanga," and below that is an Italian verse signed "GAZZOLETTI."
